int.kg.kommission: The minimum wage is set by the Minimum Wage Commission, not by parliament (Labour Act Art. 39). Your five government representatives vote as you instruct them; together with one of the other two sides, the commission decides on {datum}.
int.kg.kommissionLaufend: The Minimum Wage Commission is already deliberating on your instruction. No majority in parliament is needed.
int.kg.kommissionHinweis: The instruction pays for the political work. Implementation starts only once the commission decides; approval and social outcomes are not granted in advance.
